content:
On Feb 2, 2026, Optimism's development focused on enhancing system robustness and developer experience. Key achievements include significant upgrades to `proxyd` with new healthcheck and drain functionalities, safeguards against beta-tagged contracts in production upgrades, and updates to Rust subtrees for `op-alloy` and `op-reth`. Ongoing discussions centered on refining `op-supernode`'s safe label adjustments, integrating Flashblocks support into Geth, and addressing `BlockNotFoundError` in withdrawal proofs, highlighting a potential discrepancy in output root validation between Optimism SDK and Viem.

## 🚨 Needs Attention
- **Urgent Discussions**:
    - `op-supernode`: Safe Label Adjusting ([#18976](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/18976)): The discussion suggests leaning towards the CL having a full set of pointers and remaining the sole controller of the engine, except for interop resets, to avoid issues with multiple stateful controllers.
    - Flashblocks Support within Geth ([#756](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/756)): `maoueh` provided a link to their `op-geth` version with Firehose Live Tracer and Flashblock(s) support, indicating existing functionality that could be merged.
    - `BlockNotFoundError` in Step 5 (Prove the withdrawal on L1) ([#1956](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/1956)): `opfocus` highlighted a potential discrepancy in output-root validation between Optimism SDK and Viem, which could contribute to the error.

## ✅ Completed Work
### Infrastructure & System Robustness
- **Enhanced `proxyd` Functionality**: A significant feature was added to `proxyd`, introducing configurable HTTP probe workers for backend health checking and the ability to exclude failing backends, improving reliability and resilience. ([#534](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/pull/534))
- **Production Upgrade Safeguards**: A new feature was added to block contracts with beta tags from being used in production upgrades, ensuring stability and preventing premature deployment of unfinalized code. ([#19035](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19035))
- **Transaction Manager Improvements**: The transaction manager now correctly uses the blob tip cap when increasing fees for blob transactions, aligning fee bumping logic with initial transaction creation. ([#19028](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19028))
- **Betanet RevShare Functionality**: Two new betanet tasks were added for Sepolia to upgrade and configure RevShare functionality for the `revshare-beta-1` chain, updating it to U18. ([#1365](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/pull/1365), [#1366](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/pull/1366))

### Core Development & Tooling Updates
- **Rust Subtree Updates and Build Fixes**: All Rust subtrees, including `op-alloy` and `op-reth`, were updated to their latest versions, incorporating recent changes and improvements. ([#19025](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19025))
- **Buildx Workaround & CI Fixes**: A workaround was implemented to address issues with older `buildx` versions during prestate building, and the `just` version was added to the legacy Kona prestate build configuration to fix CI failures. ([#19031](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19031), [#19046](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19046))
- **`op-geth` Dependency Update**: The `fork.yaml` reference was updated to `v1.16.8` from `v1.16.5`. ([#760](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/pull/760))

### Website & Documentation Enhancements
- **Core Website Updates**: A new `index.html` file was added to the repository, indicating foundational updates or additions to the website's structure. ([#1265](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/pull/1265))
- **RNBW Token Integration**: The RNBW token was integrated, including its data, logo, and icon files, suggesting an expansion of supported tokens or assets within the Optimism ecosystem. ([#1264](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/pull/1264))
- **Task Submission Process Improvements**: The `NEW_TASK_GUIDE.md` was updated to include a "Before Submitting Your Task for Review" section, requiring task authors to follow best practices and simulation requirements. ([#1357](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/pull/1357))

## 🏗️ Work in Progress
### New Pull Requests
- **ethereum-optimism/optimism**:
    - [#19053](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19053) supernode: Handle genesis L2 block in L1AtSafeHead lookup
    - [#19052](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19052) fix: only allow enabling permissioned game types in opcm v2
    - [#19051](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19051) op-supernode: Interop Message Validation
    - [#19050](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19050) feat(op-reth): pull latest superchain config on startup
    - [#19049](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19049) feat(op-deployer): e2e parallel test protection
    - [#19048](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19048) op-devstack: add sysgo integration for op-interop-filter
    - [#19047](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19047) maint: add clearer comment to safe block enrichment
    - [#19045](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19045) feat(op-node): add generic upgrade gas mechanism
    - [#19044](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19044) feat(op-reth-hist-proofs): Import op-reth historical proofs code from op-rs fork
    - [#19043](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19043) feat(op-reth-hist-proofs): Move op-reth binary into subdir
    - [#19042](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19042) add skip-heavy-fuzz label support for ci
    - [#19041](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19041) test(contracts): enhance LegacyMintableERC20 test coverage
- **ethereum-optimism/docs**:
    - [#1972](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/pull/1972) fix: missing fee vault recipients in rollup setup
- **ethereum-optimism/design-docs**:
    - [#365](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/design-docs/pull/365) feat: SuperDisputeGame migration design doc

### Active Discussions
- **`op-supernode`: Safe Label Adjusting** ([#18976](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18976)): Discussions continue on how the `op-supernode` should manage and interpret "safe" labels across different layers, with a focus on the CL maintaining full control of the engine.
- **Flashblocks Support within Geth** ([#756](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/756)): The integration of flashblocks support into `op-geth` is being discussed, with existing `op-geth` versions already having this functionality.
- **`BlockNotFoundError` in Withdrawal Proof** ([#1956](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/1956)): Users are encountering `BlockNotFoundError` during the withdrawal proof step, with a potential gap in Viem's output root validation identified as a contributing factor.

## 🐞 Issue Triage
### Closed Issues
- **ethereum-optimism/docs**:
    - [#1967](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/issues/1967) January 2026 Metrics Report: Closed Issues
    - [#1968](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/issues/1968) January 2026 Metrics Report: Opened Pull Requests

## ✨ Contributor Spotlight
- **geoknee**: Provided significant updates and refined proposals for the `op-supernode: Safe Label Adjusting` discussion across multiple repositories, influencing the direction of this critical architectural decision.
- **maoueh**: Contributed valuable insights and a link to their `op-geth` version with Firehose Live Tracer and Flashblock(s) support, advancing the discussion on `Flashblocks Support within Geth`.
- **opfocus**: Highlighted a crucial discrepancy in output root validation between Optimism SDK and Viem regarding the `BlockNotFoundError` in withdrawal proofs, providing key analysis for a persistent user issue.
